sources.entry: Noteship - Local-first note-taking app for turning notes into structured knowledge. [![App Store][app-store Icon]](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/noteship/id1571711347?platform=mac)

summary.name: Noteship
summary.one_liner: Noteship is a Mac note-taking app that combines notes, todos, and reminders, stored locally as plain files and folders.
use_cases: Drafting blog posts, term papers, or books with outlines
Preparing for meetings with notes, action items, and attached slides or PDFs
Keeping a personal CRM of contacts and details
Building a Zettelkasten of linked notes
summary.what_it_does: Noteship lets users write notes, nest sub-notes under other notes, folders, and files, and track todos and reminders. Mentioning a note, place, or person creates a link, and bi-directional backlinks appear at the bottom of each note. A large calendar view shows notes and reminders, and a spreadsheet view helps track details such as contacts. A One Page Summary report gathers lessons from multiple notes into a single monthly review page. Notes are saved locally as HTML files in folders visible in Finder, with no internet connection required.
notable: Notes saved as HTML files in Finder folders, readable in any browser or text editor
Bi-directional backlinks and linking by mentioning notes, places, or people
Works offline with all data stored locally on the Mac
Includes a spreadsheet view for a personal CRM and a One Page Summary monthly review report
caveats: Page says 'Try it for free!' but does not state pricing tiers or paid limits, so the pricing model is only partly clear
Only macOS is named on the page
